Deoxys

Released February 1, 2005 · 108 cards

Deoxys is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on February 1, 2005. Its main set has 107 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (108 in total). It includes 96 Pokémon, 9 Trainer and 3 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

34 illustrators worked on Deoxys. Most cards: Hisao Nakamura (7), Ken Sugimori (7), Mitsuhiro Arita (7), Atsuko Nishida (5), Hajime Kusajima (5), Ryo Ueda (5), Tomokazu Komiya (5), Aya Kusube (4).
